title: 补齐 Project 容器与 attempt/apply 产品闭环

originalAcceptance.criterion: Project 支持 master instruction 和 knowledge refs，且可迁移现有 workspace 映射。
attempt 有 immutable identity、独立 session/worktree/evidence、diff 和 verification。
apply 是显式动作并受审批。
没有多人实时协作或 Website Builder 的范围扩张。
evidence: No collaboration, Website Builder, Cloud VM or marketplace implementation was added.

boundaries: Project is read-only and does not replace Workspace.
Attempt apply is explicit, preflight-first and approval-gated; failures are preserved.
No auto merge/commit/PR, Best-of-N, Cloud attempts, realtime collaboration or Website Builder was added.
